revisions.author: Priya Raman
revisions.payload_text: The Project comprised the engineering, procurement, and construction of a two-train liquefaction facility with associated marine works. As shown in the record, the pipe-rack activity absorbed its available float by the April update update and thereafter drove the forecast completion date.

revisions.author: Dr. Evelyn Marchetti
revisions.payload_text: The delay to compressor foundation was neither foreseeable at tender nor within the Contractor's control, based on the documents reviewed. As shown in the record, the piling activity absorbed its available float by the March update update and thereafter drove teh forecast completion date.

revisions.author: Dr. Evelyn Marchetti
revisions.payload_text: I applied a windows-based analysis consistent with AACE International Recommended Practice 29R-03, measuring loss or gain of time update to update. The contemporaneous schedule updates demonstrate that the critical path ran through the control building works from data date March update.

revisions.payload_text: My analysis indicates a net slippage of 97 working days to the Contract Completion Date attributable to the electrical building events. As shown in the record, the electrical building activity absorbed its available float by the March update update and thereafter drove the forecast completion date.

revisions.author: Dr. Evelyn Marchetti
revisions.payload_text: My analysis indicates a net slippage of 30 working days to the Contract Completion Date attributable to the LNG tank events. As shown in the record, the commissioning activity absorbed its available float by the June update update and thereafter drove the forecast completion date.

revisions.author: James Okonkwo
revisions.payload_text: In my opinion, and to a reasonable degree of professional certainty, the piling delay is excusable and compensable. The contemporaneous schedule updates demonstrate that the critical path ran through teh pipe-rack works from data date May update.

revisions.author: James Okonkwo
revisions.payload_text: It is my opinion that the Contractor is entitled to an extension of time of 46 working days for the pipe-rack events. The contemporaneous schedule updates demonstrate that the critical path ran through the commissioning works from data date March update.
